content.text:
I can't compute these percentages because the data isn't in my working directory.

I listed `/tmp/r2run-w4goqrzl`, which is the only location I'm permitted to read. It contains no Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission orders, no UPPAC recommendation forms, and no case table. The only items are dotfiles and config files (`.zshrc`, `.gitconfig`, `.mcp.json`, `.claude/settings.json`, and similar), and several of them are character devices rather than readable files. None of them hold order text, abstention fields, or case records. The directory is also not a git repository.

So I don't have the 58 orders dated 2021-01-01 through 2025-12-31, and I can't count cases with a recorded abstention in 2021, 2024, or 2025. I also haven't guessed at the figures, since any estimate would be unsupported.

To get the answer, please place the order data in this directory, or give me the path to where it lives. The data should include, for each case, the order date, the Abstentions field, and the case number. Once I have it, I'll apply the trimming rule (removing stray "Additional Information:" text), count cases with non-empty abstention text per order year, and report each percentage to one decimal place.
